name: Viganj (Pelješac)
notes: Pelješac channel; reliable afternoon maestral (W–NW) in summer, very gusty under the mountain. Schools on site.

name: Neretva delta
notes: Shallow river-mouth beach (Ušće Neretve); summer maestral in the afternoon, flat to small chop. Good for learning; schools on site.

name: Nin – Kraljičina plaža
notes: Shallow sandy lagoon-like beach; maestral (NW) and jugo. Standing depth, good for learning; schools on site.

name: Premantura (Kamenjak)
notes: Southern tip of Istria; works with jugo (SE) and maestral. Schools in season.
